name: recommend
summary: Turn one deterministic document analysis into the final approval recommendation.
description:
Final step of the canonical doc-approval pipeline (spec 069): consumes the doc-approval.analyze output and produces a genuine, independent second-pass recommendation, rationale, and confidence -- not an echo of the input. It recomputes a confidence rank from the actual signal counts (docType/parties/amounts found) and takes the more conservative of that and the input's own stated confidence, downgrading the recommendation with a rationale explaining why whenever the input's stated confidence doesn't match what the signals actually support.

On every recommendation, the WASM guest calls traverse_host::emit_event for doc-approval.recommendation-issued@1.0.0 with payload {docType, recommendation, confidence, rationale}.

Source: capability-src/doc-approval-recommend/ in this repo.

use_cases.scenario: As an approvals manager, I want a high-confidence analysis backed by real extracted signals to be confirmed as approvable, so that well-supported documents move through the pipeline without unnecessary manual review.

output_example.rationale: docType=invoice; 1 party found; 1 amount found; confirmed at high confidence

use_cases.scenario: As an approvals manager, I want a claimed high-confidence analysis with no actual supporting signals to be independently recomputed and downgraded, so that a downstream bug or bad input can't silently push an unsupported document through as approved.

output_example.rationale: docType=general; 0 parties found; 0 amounts found; downgraded from high confidence because detected signals only support low

use_cases.scenario: As an approvals manager, I want a partial-signal analysis to yield manual_review at medium confidence, so that borderline documents get human attention.

output_example.rationale: docType=invoice; 1 party found; 0 amounts found; confirmed at medium confidence

preconditions.description: The caller provides the doc-approval.analyze output fields.

postconditions.description: The capability returns a recommendation, rationale, and confidence genuinely derived from the provided analysis fields -- distinct inputs produce distinct outputs, deterministically, including downgrading a recommendation whose stated confidence outpaces its actual signal count.

side_effects.description: Produces one deterministic recommendation payload for the provided analysis.
Emits doc-approval.recommendation-issued@1.0.0 via traverse_host::emit_event on every recommendation

authoring.test_evidence: cargo test in capability-src mirrors; wasm imports include traverse_host::emit_event
